title: JEEM: Vision-Language Understanding in Four Arabic Dialects

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on image captioning and visual question answering tasks using a benchmark of images that depict culturally specific elements, traditions, and environments from four Arab countries, contrasting their performance on geographically diverse data against typical Western-centric models.

Assessing the models' linguistic competence, fluency, and dialect authenticity when processing and generating text in four specific Arabic dialects (Jordanian, Emirati, Egyptian, Moroccan) as opposed to standardized Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) or English.
